Led by second-year head coach [[Travis Steele]], they played their home games at the [[Cintas Center]] in [[Cincinnati|Cincinnati, Ohio]]. They finished the season 19–13, 8–10 in [[2019–20 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a tie for sixth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2020 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to [[2019–20 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|DePaul]]. Soon thereafter, all postseason tournaments were canceled due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]] which effectively ended their season. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Musketeers]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 19–16, 9–9 in [[2018–19 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in third place.{{cite web |title=2018-19 Xavier Musketeers Roster and Stats |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/xavier/2019.html |accessdate=23 March 2019}} They defeated [[2018–19 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]] in the quarterfinals before losing to [[2018–19 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]] in the semifinals of the [[2019 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]]. The Musketeers failed to receive a bid to a postseason tournament.{{cite news |last1=Baum |first1=Adam |title=March Madness 2019: Xavier Musketeers basketball miss NCAA Tournament, Big East gets 4 in |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/xavier/xaviersports/2019/03/17/xavier-musketeers-basketball-misses-ncaa-tournament/3197263002/ |accessdate=23 March 2019}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
